items.headline: FBI team wraps up cyber-fraud visit
items.summary: An FBI and US Justice Department team ended a week in Sri Lanka working with the Attorney General's Department and police on scam-centre cases, including evidence from over 80 seized devices. They also trained local investigators, and both sides plan to keep sharing leads.

items.headline: Two political figures remanded
items.summary: A Sarvajana Balaya activist held in Thambuttegama over alleged links to organised crime was remanded until November 30. Separately, a former SLPP local election candidate from Diyathalawa, caught with 2.4g of crystal meth, was remanded until December 1.

items.headline: 776 child sex-abuse complaints in 10 months
items.summary: The National Child Protection Authority logged 776 complaints of sexual offences against children so far this year. They include 192 rape complaints.

items.headline: Arrest in fatal Nawala hit-and-run
items.summary: Police went through more than 100 CCTV recordings and arrested a driver in Horana over the November 10 crash that killed an 80-year-old pedestrian in Nawala. The suspect tested positive for methamphetamine and was remanded until November 27.

items.headline: Amber lightning warning for 14 districts
items.summary: The Met Department warned of severe lightning until 11 PM tonight in 14 districts, including Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Kurunegala and Ratnapura.

items.headline: Sajith links weak Motor Show turnout to tight budgets
items.summary: At the Colombo Motor Show, Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa said attendance was down because ordinary people have little money, even with strong state finances. He also called for local vehicle manufacturing instead of imports.

items.headline: Revised labour law awareness drive begins
items.summary: Provincial awareness programmes on the revised labour laws began today, starting in the Southern Province. Deputy Labour Minister Mahinda Jayasinghe said the changes were first briefed to employers and unions.

items.headline: Tax returns due November 30
items.summary: The Inland Revenue Department reminded corporate, partnership and individual taxpayers that 2025/26 income tax returns must be filed by November 30 to avoid penalties.

items.headline: Rs. 2.14bn repair of Horton Plains road begins
items.summary: The Road Development Authority started rebuilding the cyclone-damaged Blackpool–Ambewela–Pattipola–Horton Plains road in Nuwara Eliya. Completion is due in March 2028.

items.headline: Body found in Kollupitiya
items.summary: A man's body with injuries was found near Alfred House Avenue in Kollupitiya. Police have not yet said whether it was a homicide or a suicide.

items.headline: Appeal court cuts priest's rape sentence
items.summary: The Court of Appeal upheld a Hindu priest's conviction for the 2011 rape of a 17-year-old in Mullaitivu, but cut his term from 17 to 13 years.

items.headline: Child-harassment sentence suspended on appeal
items.summary: The Court of Appeal changed a three-year jail term for a man who harassed an 8-year-old girl when he was 18 into a suspended sentence. It raised the compensation to Rs. 150,000.

items.headline: Russian cargo ship burning off Finland
items.summary: The Russian freighter Sparta II was still on fire a day after a drone strike in the Baltic. Finland's military believes Ukraine was likely behind it, and all 16 crew were evacuated.

items.headline: Nigeria boat accident toll rises to 24
items.summary: The death toll from a boat accident in Nigeria has climbed to 24.
